name: Ouma Kokichi
source:
"Because I’m an evil supreme leader, I’ve done nothing but bad things so far."

A student who claims to be the “Supreme Leader of a secret society of over 10,000 members.” Because he’s an evil supreme leader, he will unabashedly tell lies and he is also an elusive person who admits to being a liar, says whatever he’s thinking, and will shed crocodile tears. It’s unknown if his secret society actually exists, but the SHSL Detective [url=/c53393]Shuuichi[/url] recalls something about a secret organization, so the matter is shrouded in mystery. 

[Edited from [url=http://jinjojess.tumblr.com/post/152613688578/ndrv3-famitsu-info-for-november-2nd-2016-its]jinjojess's translation[/url]]

[spoiler]In reality, his organization, "DICE", has only 10 members in it, and their goal was to pull off "laughable crimes without killing anyone".[/spoiler]
